test_safe_indexing: test the _safe_indexing function to safely select rows or columns from arrays, sparse matrices, dataframes, polars, and pyarrow containers
test_determine_key_type: test the _determine_key_type function to classify indexing keys as int, bool, str, or slice types
test_get_column_indices: test the _get_column_indices function to resolve column names or integer indices from pandas and polars dataframes
test_safe_assign: test the _safe_assign function to safely assign values to row or column subsets of arrays, sparse matrices, and dataframes
test_resample: test the resample function to randomly sample data with optional stratification, replacement, and sample weights
test_shuffle: test the shuffle function to randomly reorder arrays, lists, sparse matrices, and custom dataframes along the first axis
